headline: Jio IPO: RIL Shareholders to Get Special Reservation Quota, Also Allowed to Apply Through Retail Too
summary: Reliance Industries shareholders holding shares as of the RHP filing date can apply under a special reserved quota in Jio's upcoming IPO. Eligible shareholders may also apply in the general retail category.
why: Reliance Jio is the telecom and digital arm of Reliance Industries, India's largest conglomerate by market value. Its IPO is a major test of appetite for large Indian listings.

impacts.name: Reliance Industries
impacts.why: The IPO allocation rules for Jio shareholders directly concern the parent company's shareholder base.
